title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཇེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 176)
shelf_note: Authentic folio from the Pramāṇa (epistemology) section of the Derge Tengyur.

tr_errors_A.problem: Inaccurate Sanskrit reconstruction (samakara instead of saṃsṛṣṭākāra/saṃkīrṇākāra for mixed/blended aspect)

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately preserves the dialectical commentary structure, properly tags the sentence continuation from the preceding folio, and provides precise Sanskrit philosophical terminology.

book_verdict: Clear, well-preserved folio from the Derge Tengyur Pramāṇa section with accurate OCR transcription and high-quality translation.
